backend/main.mo: Defines core domain types (subscriptions, confidence, tickets, matches, users, predictions) and comparison helpers, integrating authorization via MixinAuthorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two Live Page camera-recording features, their affected files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries for many frontend files describing UI, routing, styling, authentication, admin logic, and analytics components.
frontend/index.css: Empty stylesheet placeholder for global frontend styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point mounting the app and loading src/main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes and wraps the app with ThemeProvider and AppLayout.
frontend/src/components/admin/AccessDeni: Renders an access-denied card with a message and a button linking back to home.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminBoots: Provides admin bootstrap flow including profile update form, validation, and bootstrap mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminRoute: Route guard that handles admin checks, bootstrap availability, role errors, and renders admin content or fallback screens.
frontend/src/components/admin/AiPredicti: Empty placeholder component file for AI predictions admin tab.
frontend/src/components/ai/AiConfidenceB: Empty placeholder component file for AI confidence badge.
frontend/src/components/ai/AiInsightsSec: Empty placeholder component file for AI insights section.
frontend/src/components/analytics/AdminA: Empty placeholder component file for admin analytics tab.
frontend/src/components/analytics/MyPerf: Empty placeholder component file for user performance analytics panel.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with loading states and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog prompting new authenticated users to create a profile with name and email.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAuth: Displays a login prompt if no identity is present, otherwise renders its children.
frontend/src/components/aviator/Distribu: Renders distribution buckets with percentages and colored progress bars.
frontend/src/components/aviator/GamesTab: Shows a table of games with multiplier, duration, and timestamp, or a message if empty.
Displays a KPI metric with an icon and optional trend indicator.
frontend/src/components/aviator/Multipli: Draws an SVG sparkline chart of multiplier values with gradient fill and data points.
frontend/src/components/gamification/Vip: Shows a placeholder VIP leaderboard card indicating the feature is coming soon.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main app layout with header, navigation, auth gating, and routed content.
frontend/src/components/live/CameraCaptu: Provides camera preview and video recording controls with error handling and playback.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Botto: Renders a mobile bottom tab bar with navigation icons and active-state highlighting.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Prima: Displays primary navigation links with admin support and mobile/desktop variants.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useAviatorQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching games and patterns and simulating new game data through an actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUser.ts: Fetches the current user's profile and role and exposes loading and admin state helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity context/provider handling login, stored identities, and authentication state.
frontend/src/hooks/useMediaRecorder.ts: Custom hook that manages video recording with MediaRecorder, including start, stop, pause, resume, and download functionality.
Automatically redirects users after login based on their role and identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains mutations and queries for saving profiles, admin bootstrap checks, and role assignment via the actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind-based global styles and a neon-themed dark UI with custom variables and utility classes.
frontend/src/lib/aiConfidence.ts: Empty placeholder file for AI confidence utilities.
frontend/src/lib/gamification.ts: Generates a list of earned badges based on user performance statistics.
frontend/src/lib/share.ts: Builds shareable text and URLs for user stats and provides a clipboard copy helper.
frontend/src/lib/subscription.ts: Maps subscription types to labels and determines VIP access eligibility.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app, wrapping it with query and identity providers before rendering.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx: Renders the admin panel UI within an access-restricted admin route.
frontend/src/pages/AnalysisPage.tsx: Empty page file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/pages/AnalyticsPage.tsx: Displays statistical analysis of recent game multipliers, including mean, median, quartiles, and distribution charts.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Provides KPI metrics and trend analysis for recent game multipliers with sparkline visualization.
frontend/src/pages/LivePage.tsx: Shows real-time simulated or camera-based game feed with polling, distribution stats, and controls.
frontend/src/pages/MonteCarloPage.tsx: Runs a configurable local Monte Carlo simulation and displays mock risk and return results.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Displays authenticated user profile info including name, email, join date, and subscription status.
frontend/src/pages/SimulatorPage.tsx: Generates simulated games, displays multipliers, and shows results in tables and charts.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash-based), persist them in sessionStorage, and clear them from the URL or storage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining dark mode, content paths, extended theme colors, fonts, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: JSON metadata describing project state, architecture notes, issues, and existing feature specifications for the app.
